title: TOP 5 STOCKS TO WATCH THIS WEEK | EARNINGS WEEK
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: Markets are technically oversold and a bounce would make sense, but the dip can keep dipping, so buy quality with small positions and no leverage.
Netflix, SpaceX, Tesla, Meta, IBM earnings will set the tone for big tech.
High oil prices from Middle East tensions are the catalyst depressing airlines; easing oil would help them recover.
Bitcoin has no inherent value and Bitcoin treasury companies like MSTR/MARA are worthless.
